items.title: Capita boss exits and shares crash as firm cuts profit forecasts over pension failures
items.summary: Capita shares fell sharply and CEO Adolfo Hernandez departed with immediate effect after administrative failures in the UK Civil Service Pension Scheme.

items.title: RiverStone assumes portfolio of NHBC new-home warranty liabilities
items.summary: Legacy insurer RiverStone International has entered into a bespoke transaction with the National House-Building Council to cover a portfolio of UK new-home warranty liabilities.

items.title: EdenTree promotes Phil Baker to CEO as Andy Clark retires
items.summary: Phil Baker is set to take over as chief executive of EdenTree Investment Management from January 2027 following Andy Clark's retirement.

items.title: Greater Manchester Police investigate unknown substance after 12,000 evacuated from Co-op Live
items.summary: Greater Manchester Police declared a major incident and launched an investigation after more than 12,000 fans were evacuated from Manchester's Co-op Live arena during a concert.

items.title: Reinsurance cut stress test gross losses by around 72%, PRA reveals
items.summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority has published the results of its 2026 Dynamic General Insurance Stress Test, showing that reinsurance reduced gross losses from participating events by approximately 72%.

items.title: EPG launches industry-wide benefit specification for de-risking deals
items.summary: The Endgame Perspectives Group has released a standardised framework to bring consistency to benefit descriptions in pension de-risking transactions.
